ev.q: Overall, 805 (24.9%) specimens tested positive for any virus (95% CI = 23.4%–26.4%).
A substantially higher percentage of pre-K specimens tested positive (40.0%) compared with staff member specimens (14.1%) (p<0.001).
Logistic regression models were used to compare positivity across age groups.
To determine the prevalence of respiratory viruses in school students and staff members, prospective surveillance was implemented

methods_quotes.q: Logistic regression models were used to compare positivity across age groups.
Regression models accounted for clustering within schools when calculating cluster-robust SEs.
Percentile-based bootstrapped CIs were calculated using Stata 17 software (version 17.0; StataCorp).
